sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For our current offer, we propose a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. A longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in, and the contract term is reflected in the price. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

Alternatively, we can offer a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body: We reviewed the referenced records. The letter (ref below) announces an increase of 6.2 % from 1 December, and the framework agreement caps pass-through at that level. Weighing this, our counter stands. Our position is unchanged.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We note your response, but the records you cite were already fully accounted for in our previous offer, and we have already taken that notice period data into account. As your proposed price has decreased without any new supporting data, we cannot make further concessions. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Therefore, we maintain our offer of €52.30 and ask that you provide new verifiable figures if we are to review our position. For clarity, our firm offer stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please keep in mind that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship with your company and look forward to continuing our professional dialogue.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We received a lot of material and looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that notice period data into account, and the records you cite were already fully accounted for in our previous offer. We note your statement that this is your final position, but as your proposed price has decreased again without any new supporting data, we cannot make further concessions. 

Therefore, we must state that €52.30 is our final offer for these terms. Our Angebot is a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
